request: Add a decorator in CTFd utils that redirects non-logged-in users to the registration page instead of login.

summary.result_text:
I added `authed_or_register` to `CTFd/utils/decorators/__init__.py`. I haven't run it or added tests.

It works like `authed_only`, with one difference. A logged-in user goes straight through to the view. A non-logged-in user is redirected to `auth.register`, with `next` set to the current path so they return to the page after signing up. JSON and event-stream requests still get a 403 instead of a redirect.

The file already had a `members_only` decorator that redirects to registration. It only checks that a `session` cookie exists, not that the user is actually authenticated, so I left it alone and wrote a separate decorator.

To use it, put `@authed_or_register` on a view in place of `@authed_only`.
